attivo.name: Sync the token to the portrait
attivo.hint: When you give an actor a new portrait, the token follows — but only if it was already following, or was still a placeholder. A token chosen on purpose stays as it is.

soloPng.name: NPCs only
soloPng.hint: Leave player characters out, even when their token was following the portrait.

segnaposto.name: Placeholder portraits
segnaposto.hint: One image path per line. These are never copied to a token, and a token that still has one is treated as not chosen.

prefissi.name: Placeholder folders
prefissi.hint: One path prefix per line: everything under it is treated as a placeholder (default: Foundry's built-in icons).

cartellaMiniature.name: Thumbnail folder
cartellaMiniature.hint: If the portrait is at <folder>/x and the token at /x, they are the same art at two resolutions and are not synced (dnd5e convention). Empty = disabled.

menu.name: Existing actors
menu.label: Sync existing tokens…
menu.hint: Shows a preview, then syncs only tokens that are empty or still a placeholder. Never touches a token that already has its own art.

dialog.title: Sync existing tokens
dialog.summary: {daAllineare} actors to sync, {saltati} left as they are.

motivo.segnaposto: the portrait is empty or a placeholder
motivo.miniatura: the portrait is the thumbnail of the same token
motivo.tokenScelto: the token already has its own art
